decisions.reason: The placeholder-clearing scope extension does not alter the date-entry method or its scope; the separate date-functionality requests already have their own same-message MODIFY.
Placeholder activation and text wrapping are independent behaviors, and the wrapping requirement already represents the separate feedback in this message.
Extending automatic placeholder clearing does not change the Board Seminar field's multiline-input behavior.
The placeholder-clearing scope change does not modify the checklist-and-dropdown configuration.
Applying placeholder clearing in additional templates does not necessarily change the established field architecture or editable-text mechanism.
The scope extension does not change label coverage, help-text content, locations, or persistence; those requirements remain applicable without a state update.
Hard-return spacing is an independent formatting behavior and is not changed by extending placeholder activation behavior.
The source decision changes where placeholders clear, not their Danish labels or placeholder text.
The placeholder-clearing scope extension does not alter the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting during interaction.
Automatic clearing in additional templates does not necessarily change the established visible instructional-text cue requirement.
Guidance-template margin stability is independent of placeholder clearing and already has separate same-message evidence.
Extending placeholder activation behavior does not change Enter-key bullet creation.
